name: @w6w-apps/freshdesk
description: Manage Freshdesk tickets, contacts and companies.

w6w.longDescription:
Freshdesk manages the full lifecycle of a support ticket from a workflow — creating, updating, fetching, listing and deleting tickets, and adding both internal notes and customer-facing replies to keep a conversation moving without an agent opening Freshdesk directly.

Contacts and companies round out the picture: contacts can be created, updated, fetched and listed, and companies can be fetched and listed, so a workflow can look up or create the requester behind a ticket as part of the same process that files it.

A fit for routing an external event — a form submission, an email, an alert from another system — into a new Freshdesk ticket, updating tickets as a workflow progresses through its own steps, or syncing contact and company data between Freshdesk and a CRM.
